**$O_c$** (perp. bisector of $AB$: midpoint $(5/2,6)$, slope $12/5$, perp $-5/12$): Meets $CB$ at $H=(169/10,0)$ and $CA$ at $I=(279/22,58/33)$. Circumcenter of $CHI$: perp. bisector of $CH$ is $x=309/20$; perp. bisector of $CI$ at $x=309/20$ gives $y=406/165$. So $O_c=(309/20,406/165)$.

## Circumcircle of $O_aO_bO_c$

Solving $|X-O_a|^2=|X-O_b|^2=|X-O_c|^2$ for $X=(h,k)$ yields:
$$O'=\left(\tfrac{13991}{1980},\,\tfrac{49259}{10560}\right), \qquad R'=\tfrac{54925}{6336}.$$

## Verifying tangency

$$O'-O=\left(\tfrac{13991}{1980}-7,\;\tfrac{49259}{10560}-\tfrac{33}{8}\right)=\left(\tfrac{131}{1980},\,\tfrac{5699}{10560}\right).$$

$$|O'-O|^2=\tfrac{131^2}{1980^2}+\tfrac{5699^2}{10560^2}=\tfrac{17225^2}{31680^2}=\left(\tfrac{3445}{6336}\right)^2.$$

$$R'-R=\tfrac{54925}{6336}-\tfrac{65}{8}=\tfrac{54925-51480}{6336}=\tfrac{3445}{6336}=|O'-O|.$$

Since $R'>R$ and $|O'-O|=R'-R$, the circle $(O_aO_bO_c)$ contains $(ABC)$ and is **internally tangent** to it.

## Finding $P$

The tangency point lies on line $O'O$, on the side of $O$ away from $O'$:
$$P = O + R\cdot\frac{O-O'}{|O-O'|}.$$

The unit vector $\vec u = \frac{O-O'}{|O-O'|} = \left(\tfrac{-2096}{17225},\,\tfrac{-17097}{17225}\right)$ (verified: $2096^2+17097^2=17225^2$).

$$P = \left(7,\tfrac{33}{8}\right)+\tfrac{65}{8}\left(\tfrac{-2096}{17225},\,\tfrac{-17097}{17225}\right)=\left(\tfrac{1593}{265},\,-\tfrac{1044}{265}\right).$$

**Verification:** $|P-O|^2 = \left(\tfrac{262}{265}\right)^2+\left(\tfrac{17097}{2120}\right)^2 = \tfrac{17225^2}{2120^2}=\tfrac{65^2}{8^2}=R^2$. ✓

## Computing $AP$

$$\vec{AP}=\left(\tfrac{1593}{265}-5,\;-\tfrac{1044}{265}-12\right)=\left(\tfrac{268}{265},\;-\tfrac{4224}{265}\right).$$

$$AP^2=\tfrac{268^2+4224^2}{265^2}=\tfrac{71824+17842176}{70225}=\tfrac{17914000}{70225}=\tfrac{13520}{53}.$$

Since $13520=2^4\cdot 5\cdot 13^2$ and $265=5\cdot 53$:

$$AP=\sqrt{\tfrac{13520}{53}}=\tfrac{52\sqrt{5}}{\sqrt{53}}=\boxed{\dfrac{52\sqrt{265}}{53}}.$$

Solving $|X-O_a|^2=|X-O_b|^2=|X-O_c|^2$ for $X=(h,k)$ yields:
$$O'=\left(\tfrac{13991}{1980},\,\tfrac{49259}{10560}\right), \qquad R'=\tfrac{54925}{6336}.$$

## Verifying tangency

$$O'-O=\left(\tfrac{13991}{1980}-7,\;\tfrac{49259}{10560}-\tfrac{33}{8}\right)=\left(\tfrac{131}{1980},\,\tfrac{5699}{10560}\right).$$

$$|O'-O|^2=\tfrac{131^2}{1980^2}+\tfrac{5699^2}{10560^2}=\tfrac{17225^2}{31680^2}=\left(\tfrac{3445}{6336}\right)^2.$$

The tangency point lies on line $O'O$, on the side of $O$ away from $O'$:
$$P = O + R\cdot\frac{O-O'}{|O-O'|}.$$

The unit vector $\vec u = \frac{O-O'}{|O-O'|} = \left(\tfrac{-2096}{17225},\,\tfrac{-17097}{17225}\right)$ (verified: $2096^2+17097^2=17225^2$).

$$\vec{AP}=\left(\tfrac{1593}{265}-5,\;-\tfrac{1044}{265}-12\right)=\left(\tfrac{268}{265},\;-\tfrac{4224}{265}\right).$$

$$AP^2=\tfrac{268^2+4224^2}{265^2}=\tfrac{71824+17842176}{70225}=\tfrac{17914000}{70225}=\tfrac{13520}{53}.$$

Since $13520=2^4\cdot 5\cdot 13^2$ and $265=5\cdot 53$:

$$AP=\sqrt{\tfrac{13520}{53}}=\tfrac{52\sqrt{5}}{\sqrt{53}}=\boxed{\dfrac{52\sqrt{265}}{53}}.$$
